title: WhatsApp announces Events Home and shareable event invites
description: WhatsApp users can already create events in a 1:1 conversation and group chats. Now they can also create events that they can share with people who don't have a WhatsApp account. "Create an event, add a cover photo, share the link, and they can see details and RSVP without downloading the app," said WhatsApp in a blog post. The company also said your phone number won't be shown to event guests you don't know, and guests without a WhatsApp account will only see the event address after they RSVP. description: Oppo's Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max went global recently, and the Find X10 Ultra was expected to follow in the first half of next year as the camera-focused top dog. Today, Digital Chat Station on Weibo says Oppo's Ultra project is on hold. There's no reason given, but it's easy to guess that it all has to do with the insane memory prices which would have pushed the Find X10 Ultra to stratospheric levels, considering it was supposed to be a camera-centric flagship, and those cameras aren't cheap either. title: Samsung Galaxy Fit4 might have NFC for payments
description: The Samsung Galaxy Fit3, launched in February 2024, is due for a successor. Rumors claim the Galaxy Fit4 will arrive this year, with recent leaks revealing its design and key features. There's no word from Samsung about the Galaxy Fit4's launch; however, it has published the Galaxy Fit4 Manager app on the Galaxy Store, and the screenshots in the listing hint at NFC support. One screenshot in the listing, attached below, shows a "Wallet" option in the app's menu. It's obscure and behind the bottom navigation bar. The lineup will comprise the Honor 700, Honor 700 Pro, and Honor 700S. All three models are confirmed to feature a rear display and are now available for pre-order through Honor’s official online store in China. Honor 700 and Honor 700 Pro While a launch date hasn’t been announced yet, the phones are likely to go official later this month. title: iQOO 16s gets certified and it's eerily familiar
description: The upcoming iQOO 16R received its first certification in Indonesia last month, and today it showed up in another database, but with a twist. Malaysia's SIRIM certification lists the model number I2606 as the iQOO 16s, not the 16R. That's the same model number that showed up as the iQOO 16R in the GSM Association's IMEI database and Indonesia's TKDN listing. So it looks like iQOO will sell this phone as the 16s at least in Malaysia, though it remains to be seen which name other markets will get. The SIRIM listing doesn't reveal any specs, unfortunately. title: Samsung Galaxy S27 is headed to India, new certification reveals
description: The Samsung Galaxy S27 has already made the rounds through several certification databases, and today it has passed through another one. The handset, bearing the model number SM-S952B/DS, has just been approved by India's Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), and it's the first member of the S27 family to get there. Unfortunately, the BIS listing doesn't reveal any specs, but we already know a fair bit from the phone's earlier appearances. title: Here's when Samsung's Android XR glasses finally go up for pre-order
description: Samsung showed off its first Android XR glasses at its Galaxy Unpacked event back in July, and a recent report claimed they would go on sale in mid-December. Now we know when you'll be able to pre-order them, and the news doesn't come from Samsung or Google, but from Warby Parker, which designed some of the frames. In its third-quarter results today, Dave Gilboa, Warby Parker's Co-Founder and Co-CEO, said that the company will begin accepting pre-orders for its first Intelligent Eyewear collection on November 12. title: WhatsApp is bringing iOS-style chat previews to Android
description: WhatsApp has long let you turn read receipts off entirely, but if you keep them on, there's no easy way on Android to see what someone sent you without them knowing you've read it. The notification helps, unless you've already swiped it away or have too many messages piling up. iPhone users have had a workaround for a while now, and it looks like Android users will finally get it too. On iOS, you can long-press a conversation in the chat list to get a pop-up with its most recent messages, and doing so doesn't trigger the blue ticks. title: Samsung's over-ear headphones said to be called Galaxy Studio, design details surface
description: Samsung’s rumored high-end over-ear headphones, reportedly called Galaxy Studio, are expected to launch in early 2027 alongside the Galaxy S27 series. A new leak now offers the first details about their design. A pair of Samsung headphones bearing the model number SMU700 have appeared on the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) certification website. These are said to be the rumored Galaxy Studio headphones. The listing includes an image showing the placement of the regulatory label, which also offers a partial look at the headphones. title: Sony brings back the original Walkman headphones with USB-C
description: Back in 1979, Sony launched the original Walkman TPS-L2 cassette player alongside the MDR-3 headphones, and together they helped popularize listening to music on the go. Today, the company is bringing those headphones back for the modern era with the MDR-3R, which keep the classic look but add USB-C. The MDR-3R faithfully recreate the original design, including the lightweight open-ear build and the iconic blue and orange ear pads, which you can swap around to match your mood. Even the packaging and the instruction manual are inspired by the MDR-3's. Under the hood, the headphones...

title: Counterpoint: global DRAM revenue grows by 369% in Q3
description: Global DRAM revenue has increased by an insane 369% year-over-year thanks to strong demand for the stuff, which goes towards building new AI accelerators and data centers. The Average Selling Price (ASP) has reached $1.9 per gigabit (i.e. 1/8th of a gigabyte). The big winner here is South Korea – Samsung is the biggest player with 38% market share, while SK hynix had a 29% share. SK’s revenue grew over 40% quarter-on-quarter, but things are going better for Samsung right now. US-based Micron holds the third spot with 21% share while China’s CXMT was fourth with 9% share. title: Qualcomm will help SpaceX build Starlink Mobile's nationwide US 5G network
description: Back in August, SpaceX made it clear that it wants to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon in the US. Of course, a proper carrier needs more than satellites. Today, Qualcomm announced that SpaceX has picked its Dragonwing Cellular Infrastructure platforms for Starlink Mobile's nationwide terrestrial 5G network. The base stations will be built on the Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 platforms, along with Qualcomm's commercial-grade Layer 1 software. title: Moto Watch 2 Fit and Moto Buds 2 Ultra launch with Polar and Bose on board
description: Alongside its new flagship smartphone, the Signature 27, Motorola has also announced two new wearables today. The Moto Watch 2 Fit succeeds the original Watch Fit, and for the first time in the Fit line, it comes with fitness insights powered by Polar. The Moto Buds 2 Ultra, on the other hand, sit above the Moto Buds 2 Plus as the company's most feature-packed TWS earbuds yet.
